items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Every time they hear I'm going to play somewhere they come dashing down with their little box of things and play.

ctx.x: He came on during the second half I believe, didn't he?

That's Airto McIerid (Airto), that's Airto. He's from Brazil. He's a Brazilian percussionist and his wife Flora, they are both from Brazil. Airto was with Miles Davis for a couple of years until recently. Now he's with (Chick Corea) and he's very very good.
Every time they hear I'm going to play somewhere they come dashing down with their little box of things and play. They are ready to play with the band. (LAUGHTER).
